input.question: I want to profile the cohort of heroes whose Intelligence score matches Abomination's Intelligence score. What is their average measured weight in kg? Please round the average to two decimals.
input.evidence: Intelligence is one of the six attribute scores a hero has (Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat)

cases.sql_diff:
--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+WITH intelligence AS (
+    SELECT h.superhero_name, h.weight_kg, ha.attribute_value AS score
+    FROM main.superhero AS h
+    JOIN main.hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = h.id
+    JOIN main.attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
+    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
+)
+SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(weight_kg, 0)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
+FROM intelligence
+WHERE score = (
+    SELECT score
+    FROM intelligence
+    WHERE superhero_name = 'Abomination'
+)
+LIMIT 1

input.question: I want to know about the lightest superhero whose weight has actually been recorded. Among all heroes sharing that lightest weight, give me the largest number of superpowers any of them has. If such a hero has no powers, that counts as 0. Please return just that one number.
input.evidence: A superpower is one power a hero has, identified by its name.

cases.sql_diff:
--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+WITH power_counts AS (
+    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.power_name) AS power_count
+    FROM main.superhero AS h
+    LEFT JOIN main.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
+    LEFT JOIN main.superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
+    WHERE h.weight_kg = (
+        SELECT MIN(weight_kg)
+        FROM main.superhero
+        WHERE weight_kg <> 0
+    )
+    GROUP BY h.id
+)
+SELECT MAX(power_count) AS max_superpowers
+FROM power_counts
+LIMIT 1000
